# Block scalper

*Block-level scalper for the 1B (bar per block) mode.*

**Kind** strategy · **Resolution** 1B

A block-by-block dip buyer with a fixed take-profit and stop.

::: warning Needs the 1B fill model
All of its logic is in `event.onBlock`, which does not run in a quick backtest. Set **Fill model** to **1B** in the
strategy's Properties (Precise works too).
:::

**Entry.** On a block whose price is *Dip from high %* below the highest price of the last *Lookback blocks* blocks,
it buys up to half its equity, capped at `pool.capacity(Max impact %)`. It waits *Blocks between entries* blocks
before the next entry and never stacks entries.

**Exit.** Each buy fill places a take-profit *Take profit %* above and a stop *Stop %* below its fill price, in
`onFill`.

**Reorgs.** `lastEntryBlock` is the script's own state, so `onReorg` resets it when the chain replaces the block it
was set in: the pattern from [Events and execution order](/guide/events#reorgs).

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd>, open **Strategies** and choose **Block scalper**. Or copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor and click **Add to chart**.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lookback blocks | int | `25` |
| Dip from high % | float | `0.6` |
| Take profit % | float | `0.8` |
| Stop % | float | `1.5` |
| Max impact % | float | `0.25` |
| Blocks between entries | int | `10` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/examples/block_scalper_1b.as.js`.

```js
strategy({ name: "Block scalper", version: "0.1", market: "ALPHA:61", resolution: "1B",
           capital: { tao: 100 }, fill: { mode: "precise", latencyBlocks: 2 },
           risk: { maxPriceImpactPct: 0.3, maxIntentsPerHour: 20 } });

const look    = input.int("Lookback blocks", 25, { min: 5, max: 300 });
const dipPct  = input.float("Dip from high %", 0.6, { min: 0.1, max: 5, step: 0.1 });
const tpPct   = input.float("Take profit %", 0.8, { min: 0.1, max: 10, step: 0.1 });
const slPct   = input.float("Stop %", 1.5, { min: 0.1, max: 10, step: 0.1 });
const maxImp  = input.float("Max impact %", 0.25, { min: 0.01, max: 2, step: 0.01 });
const cooldown = input.int("Blocks between entries", 10, { min: 0, max: 1000 });

const hi = ta.highest(block.price, look);
const lo = ta.lowest(block.price, look);
plot(hi, { title: "block high", color: "#5c6878" });
plot(lo, { title: "block low", color: "#5c6878" });

let lastEntryBlock = -1;

event.onBlock((b) => {
  const pos = account.position();
  if (pos.alpha > 0 || account.openIntents().length > 0) return;
  if (b.number - lastEntryBlock < cooldown) return;
  if (!(b.price < hi.value * (1 - dipPct / 100))) return;
  const tao = math.min(account.equity() * 0.5, pool.capacity(maxImp / 100));
  if (tao < 0.1) return;
  trade.buy({ tao, maxPrice: b.price * (1 + maxImp / 100), ttlBlocks: 4, reason: "dip" });
  lastEntryBlock = b.number;
});

event.onFill((f) => {
  if (f.side !== "buy") return;
  trade.takeProfit({ price: f.price * (1 + tpPct / 100), reason: "tp" });
  trade.stop({ price: f.price * (1 - slPct / 100), reason: "sl" });
});

event.onReorg((r) => {
  if (lastEntryBlock > r.toBlock) lastEntryBlock = -1;
  log("reorg", r.fromBlock, "→", r.toBlock);
});
```
